attempted_claim: Let g = so(8,C) and let e in g be the nilpotent element with Jordan partition [3,3,1,1] (four Jordan blocks, hence outside the two-block cases already presented in the literature), with Slodowy slice S_e and finite W-algebra W(g,e). Let Y^lambda_{mu,sigma} be the explicitly parametrized truncated shifted twisted Yangian of type D with shift mu and truncation coweight lambda attached to e by the standard pyramid/Jordan-block rule, with its parabolic/RTT generators and baby-comultiplication. Prove or disprove that there is an algebra isomorphism Psi: Y^lambda_{mu,sigma} -> W(so8,e) quantizing the Slodowy slice, sending the truncated twisted-Yangian generators to the standard Premet generators of W(g,e) with matching Kazhdan filtration degrees and matching Poisson brackets on the associated graded. A complete answer is either a full proof of such an isomorphism with explicit generator images and verification of defining relations plus a graded-dimension/PBW argument, or a rigorous proof of non-isomorphism via an explicit invariant (e.g. center, abelianization, associated-graded coordinate ring, or representation dimension) that provably differs.
decisive_failure: No completeTARGET resolution is reported: the isomorphism proof requires the unpublished Pfaffian central generator for the N=4 truncated shifted twisted Yangian, and no distinguishing invariant was found since all computed graded data (centralizer dimension 10, Kazhdan degrees, slice Jacobian, component group Z/2) agree with the isomorphism; the accompanying scripts are verification evidence only and support no originality claim.
